I withdrew the finding: all five items turn out to be covered by the HMAC DV environment, even though the testplan entries are only "planned".

- **TL-UL interface (`cr_3514ec92d204`, `cr_ceb521c08f4e`):** `hw/ip/hmac/dv/sva/hmac_bind.sv` binds `tlul_assert` as a Device to `tl_i`/`tl_o`. `hmac_bind` is in `sim_tops`, so the protocol checker runs in every simulation.
- **fifo_empty interrupt (`cr_67e76dbb8ac1`, `cr_999bc3c78db5`, `cr_d16dbd9e0ca7`):** `hw/ip/hmac/dv/env/hmac_scoreboard.sv` predicts the interrupt only when the FIFO was previously full and is now empty. It clears that "was full" state on process, start, stop and continue, so no interrupt is predicted after Process or Stop. The predicted `intr_state.fifo_empty` is compared against reads from the DUT, so a wrong interrupt fails the test.

I did not confirm which tests actually read `intr_state` or that `do_read_check` is enabled. The three interrupt items rest on the scoreboard model.

The software tests in `sw/device/tests` only poll the FIFO-empty status bit, so they don't check the interrupt.
